description: This file defines the ServiceGroups class, which models the <service-groups> XML element in the OFBiz framework. It includes attributes for loader and location, with validation in the constructor.

classes.name: ServiceGroups
classes.description: A thread-safe class representing the <service-groups> XML element with loader and location attributes, providing accessors for these attributes.

methods.name: ServiceGroups
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ServiceGroups object from an XML Element. It retrieves and validates 'loader' and 'location' attributes.
